tbesh_html:
1) continuity, perpetuity, to stretch
1a) continually, continuously (as adverb)
1b) continuity (subst)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, continuance (as indefinite extension); but used only (attributively as adjective) constant (or adverbially, constantly); ellipt. the regular (daily) sacrifice
strongs_1890.derivation: from an unused root meaning to stretch;

occurrences.bsb: And place the Bread of the Presence on the table before Me at all times.
occurrences.kjv: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.

occurrences.bsb: And you are to command the Israelites to bring you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, to keep the lamps burning continually.
occurrences.kjv: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.

occurrences.bsb: Whenever Aaron enters the Holy Place, he shall bear the names of the sons of Israel over his heart on the breastpiece of judgment, as a continual reminder before the LORD.
occurrences.kjv: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy place, for a memorial before the Lord continually.

occurrences.bsb: And place the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece of judgment, so that they will also be over Aaron’s heart whenever he comes before the LORD. Aaron will continually carry the judgment of the sons of Israel over his heart before the LORD.
occurrences.kjv: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron’s heart, when he goeth in before the Lord: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the Lord continually.

occurrences.bsb: And it will be worn on Aaron’s forehead, so that he may bear the iniquity of the holy things that the sons of Israel consecrate with regard to all their holy gifts. It shall always be on his forehead, so that they may be acceptable before the LORD.
occurrences.kjv: And it shall be upon Aaron’s forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: This is what you are to offer regularly on the altar, each day: two lambs that are a year old.
occurrences.kjv: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.

occurrences.bsb: For the generations to come, this burnt offering shall be made regularly at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD, where I will meet you to speak with you.
occurrences.kjv: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the Lord: where I will meet you, to speak there unto thee.

occurrences.bsb: When Aaron sets up the lamps at twilight, he must burn the incense perpetually before the LORD for the generations to come.
occurrences.kjv: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the Lord throughout your generations.

occurrences.bsb: The fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it must not be extinguished.
occurrences.kjv: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.

occurrences.bsb: “This is the offering that Aaron and his sons must present to the LORD on the day he is anointed: a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a regular grain offering, half of it in the morning and half in the evening.
occurrences.kjv: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the Lord in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.

occurrences.bsb: “Command the Israelites to bring you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, to keep the lamps burning continually.
occurrences.kjv: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.

occurrences.bsb: Outside the veil of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron is to tend the lamps continually before the LORD from evening until morning. This is to be a permanent statute for the generations to come.
occurrences.kjv: Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the Lord continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.

occurrences.bsb: He shall tend the lamps on the pure gold lampstand before the LORD continually.
occurrences.kjv: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the Lord continually.

occurrences.bsb: Every Sabbath day the bread is to be set out before the LORD on behalf of the Israelites as a permanent covenant.
occurrences.kjv: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the Lord continually, being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.

occurrences.bsb: Over the table of the Presence they are to spread a blue cloth and place the plates and cups on it, along with the bowls and pitchers for the drink offering. The regular bread offering is to remain on it.
occurrences.kjv: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:

occurrences.bsb: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest shall oversee the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the daily grain offering, and the anointing oil. He has oversight of the entire tabernacle and everything in it, including the holy objects and their utensils.”
occurrences.kjv: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.

occurrences.bsb: It remained that way continually; the cloud would cover the tabernacle by day, and at night it would appear like fire.
occurrences.kjv: So it was alway: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.

occurrences.bsb: And tell them that this is the food offering you are to present to the LORD as a regular burnt offering each day: two unblemished year-old male lambs.
occurrences.kjv: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the Lord; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

occurrences.bsb: This is a regular burnt offering established at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, a food offering to the LORD.
occurrences.kjv: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
occurrences.kjv: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

occurrences.bsb: In addition to the regular burnt offering with its drink offering, one male goat is to be presented to the LORD as a sin offering.
occurrences.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the Lord shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

occurrences.bsb: You are to present these in addition to the regular morning burnt offering.
occurrences.kjv: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

occurrences.bsb: Offer the same food each day for seven days as a food offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD. It is to be offered with its drink offering and the regular burnt offering.
occurrences.kjv: After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

occurrences.bsb: Offer them with their drink offerings in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering. The animals must be unblemished.
occurrences.kjv: Ye shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.

occurrences.bsb: These are in addition to the monthly and daily burnt offerings with their prescribed grain offerings and drink offerings. They are a pleasing aroma, a food offering to the LORD.
occurrences.kjv: Beside the burnt offering of the month, and his meat offering, and the daily burnt offering, and his meat offering, and their drink offerings, according unto their manner, for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Include one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement and the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offerings.
occurrences.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering of it, and their drink offerings.

occurrences.bsb: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
occurrences.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

occurrences.bsb: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
occurrences.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering thereof, and their drink offerings.

occurrences.bsb: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
occurrences.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.

occurrences.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

occurrences.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.

occurrences.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.

occurrences.bsb: It is a land for which the LORD your God cares; the eyes of the LORD your God are always on it, from the beginning to the end of the year.
occurrences.kjv: A land which the Lord thy God careth for: the eyes of the Lord thy God are always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.

occurrences.bsb: “Do not be afraid,” said David, “for surely I will show you kindness for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will restore to you all the land of your grandfather Saul, and you will always eat at my table.”
occurrences.kjv: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father’s sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.

occurrences.bsb: You and your sons and servants are to work the ground for him and bring in the harvest, so that your master’s grandson may have food to eat. But Mephibosheth, your master’s grandson, is always to eat at my table.” Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
occurrences.kjv: Thou therefore, and thy sons, and thy servants, shall till the land for him, and thou shalt bring in the fruits, that thy master’s son may have food to eat: but Mephibosheth thy master’s son shall eat bread alway at my table. Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

occurrences.bsb: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, because he always ate at the king’s table, and he was lame in both feet.
occurrences.kjv: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king’s table; and was lame on both his feet.

occurrences.bsb: How blessed are your men! How blessed are these servants of yours who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom!
occurrences.kjv: Happy are thy men, happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and that hear thy wisdom.

occurrences.bsb: Then the woman said to her husband, “Behold, now I know that the one who often comes our way is a holy man of God.
occurrences.kjv: And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this is an holy man of God, which passeth by us continually.

occurrences.bsb: So Jehoiachin changed out of his prison clothes, and he dined regularly at the king’s table for the rest of his life.
occurrences.kjv: And changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.

occurrences.bsb: And the king provided Jehoiachin a daily portion for the rest of his life.
occurrences.kjv: And his allowance was a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.

occurrences.bsb: and the priests Benaiah and Jahaziel blew the trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God.
occurrences.kjv: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.

occurrences.bsb: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
occurrences.kjv: Seek the Lord and his strength, seek his face continually.

occurrences.bsb: So David left Asaph and his associates there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to minister there regularly according to the daily requirements,
occurrences.kjv: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required:

occurrences.bsb: to regularly present burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offerings, morning and evening, according to all that was written in the Law of the LORD, which He had commanded Israel to keep.
occurrences.kjv: To offer burnt offerings unto the Lord upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of the Lord, which he commanded Israel;

occurrences.bsb: Whenever burnt offerings were presented to the LORD on the Sabbaths, New Moons, and appointed feasts, they were to serve regularly before the LORD in the numbers prescribed for them.
occurrences.kjv: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the Lord in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the Lord:

occurrences.bsb: Behold, I am about to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God to dedicate to Him for burning fragrant incense before Him, for displaying the showbread continuously, and for making burnt offerings every morning and evening as well as on the Sabbaths, New Moons, and appointed feasts of the LORD our God. This is ordained for Israel forever.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, I build an house to the name of the Lord my God, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the Lord our God. This is an ordinance for ever to Israel.

occurrences.bsb: How blessed are your men! How blessed are these servants of yours who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom!
occurrences.kjv: Happy are thy men, and happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.

occurrences.bsb: When they were finished, they brought the rest of the money to the king and Jehoiada, and with it were made articles for the house of the LORD—utensils for the service and for the burnt offerings, dishes, and other objects of gold and silver. Throughout the days of Jehoiada, burnt offerings were presented regularly in the house of the LORD.
occurrences.kjv: And when they had finished it, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels for the house of the Lord, even vessels to minister, and to offer withal, and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the Lord continually all the days of Jehoiada.

occurrences.bsb: After that, they presented the regular burnt offerings and those for New Moons and for all the appointed sacred feasts of the LORD, as well as all the freewill offerings brought to the LORD.
occurrences.kjv: And afterward offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the set feasts of the Lord that were consecrated, and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: for the showbread, for the regular grain offerings and burnt offerings, for the Sabbath offerings, for the New Moons and appointed feasts, for the holy offerings, for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the duties of the house of our God.
occurrences.kjv: For the shewbread, and for the continual meat offering, and for the continual burnt offering, of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy things, and for the sin offerings to make an atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.

occurrences.bsb: I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
occurrences.kjv: I have set the Lord always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

occurrences.bsb: My eyes are always on the LORD, for He will free my feet from the mesh.
occurrences.kjv: Mine eyes are ever toward the Lord; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

occurrences.bsb: Of David, when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, so that the king drove him away. I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.
occurrences.kjv: A Psalm of David, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless the Lord at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.

occurrences.bsb: May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servant’s well-being.”
occurrences.kjv: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the Lord be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.

occurrences.bsb: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever with me.
occurrences.kjv: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.

occurrences.bsb: O LORD, do not withhold Your mercy from me; Your loving devotion and faithfulness will always guard me.
occurrences.kjv: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O Lord: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

occurrences.bsb: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “The LORD be magnified!”
occurrences.kjv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The Lord be magnified.

occurrences.bsb: I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices, and your burnt offerings are ever before Me.
occurrences.kjv: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.

occurrences.bsb: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.
occurrences.kjv: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.

occurrences.bsb: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.
occurrences.kjv: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

occurrences.bsb: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “Let God be magnified!”
occurrences.kjv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

occurrences.bsb: Be my rock of refuge, where I can always go. Give the command to save me, for You are my rock and my fortress.
occurrences.kjv: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.

occurrences.bsb: I have leaned on You since birth; You pulled me from my mother’s womb. My praise is always for You.
occurrences.kjv: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.

occurrences.bsb: But I will always hope and will praise You more and more.
occurrences.kjv: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.

occurrences.bsb: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him; may they bless him all day long.
occurrences.kjv: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.

occurrences.bsb: Yet I am always with You; You hold my right hand.
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.

occurrences.bsb: Do not disregard the clamor of Your adversaries, the uproar of Your enemies that ascends continually.
occurrences.kjv: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.

occurrences.bsb: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
occurrences.kjv: Seek the Lord, and his strength: seek his face evermore.

occurrences.bsb: May their sins always remain before the LORD, that He may cut off their memory from the earth.
occurrences.kjv: Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

occurrences.bsb: May it be like a robe wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.
occurrences.kjv: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

occurrences.bsb: I will always obey Your law, forever and ever.
occurrences.kjv: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.

occurrences.bsb: I constantly take my life in my hands, yet I do not forget Your law.
occurrences.kjv: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.

occurrences.bsb: Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes.
occurrences.kjv: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.

occurrences.bsb: A loving doe, a graceful fawn—may her breasts satisfy you always; may you be captivated by her love forever.
occurrences.kjv: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.

occurrences.bsb: Bind them always upon your heart; tie them around your neck.
occurrences.kjv: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.

occurrences.bsb: All the days of the oppressed are bad, but a cheerful heart has a continual feast.
occurrences.kjv: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed is the man who is always reverent, but he who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
occurrences.kjv: Happy is the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.

occurrences.bsb: Then the lookout shouted: “Day after day, my lord, I stand on the watchtower; night after night I stay at my post.
occurrences.kjv: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:

occurrences.bsb: Behold, I have inscribed you on the palms of My hands; your walls are ever before Me.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.

occurrences.bsb: But you have forgotten the LORD, your Maker, who stretched out the heavens and laid the foundations of the earth. You live in terror all day long because of the fury of the oppressor who is bent on destruction. But where is the fury of the oppressor?
occurrences.kjv: And forgettest the Lord thy maker, that hath stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and hast feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor?

occurrences.bsb: And now what have I here? declares the LORD. For My people have been taken without cause; those who rule them taunt, declares the LORD, and My name is blasphemed continually all day long.
occurrences.kjv: Now therefore, what have I here, saith the Lord, that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, saith the Lord; and my name continually every day is blasphemed.

occurrences.bsb: The LORD will always guide you; He will satisfy you in a sun-scorched land and strengthen your frame. You will be like a well-watered garden, like a spring whose waters never fail.
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.

occurrences.bsb: Your gates will always stand open; they will never be shut, day or night, so that the wealth of the nations may be brought into you, with their kings being led in procession.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.

occurrences.bsb: On your walls, O Jerusalem, I have posted watchmen; they will never be silent day or night. You who call on the LORD shall take no rest for yourselves,
occurrences.kjv: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the Lord, keep not silence,

occurrences.bsb: to a people who continually provoke Me to My face, sacrificing in the gardens and burning incense on altars of brick,
occurrences.kjv: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick;

occurrences.bsb: As a well gushes its water, so she pours out her evil. Violence and destruction resound in her; sickness and wounds are ever before Me.
occurrences.kjv: As a fountain casteth out her waters, so she casteth out her wickedness: violence and spoil is heard in her; before me continually is grief and wounds.

occurrences.bsb: So Jehoiachin changed out of his prison clothes, and he dined regularly at the king’s table for the rest of his life.
occurrences.kjv: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.

occurrences.bsb: And the king of Babylon provided Jehoiachin a daily portion for the rest of his life, until the day of his death.
occurrences.kjv: And for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.

occurrences.bsb: After a long time you will be summoned. In the latter years you will enter a land that has recovered from war, whose people were gathered from many nations to the mountains of Israel, which had long been desolate. They had been brought out from the nations, and all now dwell securely.
occurrences.kjv: After many days thou shalt be visited: in the latter years thou shalt come into the land that is brought back from the sword, and is gathered out of many people, against the mountains of Israel, which have been always waste: but it is brought forth out of the nations, and they shall dwell safely all of them.

occurrences.bsb: And men will be employed to continually pass through the land to cleanse it by burying the invaders who remain on the ground. At the end of the seven months they will begin their search.
occurrences.kjv: And they shall sever out men of continual employment, passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth, to cleanse it: after the end of seven months shall they search.

occurrences.bsb: You are also to provide with it every morning a grain offering of a sixth of an ephah with a third of a hin of oil to moisten the fine flour—a grain offering to the LORD. This is a permanent statute.
occurrences.kjv: And thou shalt prepare a meat offering for it every morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of an hin of oil, to temper with the fine flour; a meat offering continually by a perpetual ordinance unto the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Thus they shall provide the lamb, the grain offering, and the oil every morning as a regular burnt offering.’
occurrences.kjv: Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meat offering, and the oil, every morning for a continual burnt offering.

occurrences.bsb: It magnified itself, even to the Prince of the host; it removed His daily sacrifice and overthrew the place of His sanctuary.
occurrences.kjv: Yea, he magnified himself even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily sacrifice was taken away, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.

occurrences.bsb: And in the rebellion, the host and the daily sacrifice were given over to the horn, and it flung truth to the ground and prospered in whatever it did.
occurrences.kjv: And an host was given him against the daily sacrifice by reason of transgression, and it cast down the truth to the ground; and it practised, and prospered.

occurrences.bsb: Then I heard a holy one speaking, and another holy one said to him, “How long until the fulfillment of the vision of the daily sacrifice, the rebellion that causes desolation, and the surrender of the sanctuary and of the host to be trampled?”
occurrences.kjv: Then I heard one saint speaking, and another saint said unto that certain saint which spake, How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice, and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?

occurrences.bsb: His forces will rise up and desecrate the temple fortress. They will abolish the daily sacrifice and set up the abomination of desolation.
occurrences.kjv: And arms shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily sacrifice, and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate.

occurrences.bsb: And from the time the daily sacrifice is abolished and the abomination of desolation set up, there will be 1,290 days.
occurrences.kjv: And from the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away, and the abomination that maketh desolate set up, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.

occurrences.bsb: But you must return to your God; maintain love and justice, and always wait on your God.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment, and wait on thy God continually.

occurrences.bsb: For as you drank on My holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. They will drink and gulp it down; they will be as if they had never existed.
occurrences.kjv: For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain, so shall all the heathen drink continually, yea, they shall drink, and they shall swallow down, and they shall be as though they had not been.

occurrences.bsb: There is no healing for your injury; your wound is severe. All who hear the news of you applaud your downfall, for who has not experienced your constant cruelty?
occurrences.kjv: There is no healing of thy bruise; thy wound is grievous: all that hear the bruit of thee shall clap the hands over thee: for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?

occurrences.bsb: Will he, therefore, empty his net and continue to slay nations without mercy?
occurrences.kjv: Shall they therefore empty their net, and not spare continually to slay the nations?
